channel.title: The Friendly Shadow
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Friendly Shadow" - Clarence's Shadow is sapient, alive, and his best friend.

item.title: Re: The Friendly Shadow
item.content:encoded:
Woah man, I've only begun to revise it. I'm flattered you've already given me another review, but I need some time. I'll PM you when I think it's ready to be reviewed. Unless you feel the need to look over and review of course.

+ 'LEVEL 3 CLEARANCE REQUIRED - INPUT CREDENTIALS'

This should follow all of the following text (except for the navigator), as a government document wouldn't just redact one thing that can be discovered anyway with context clues. Also, it probably shouldn't have the inverted commas around it.

As for this, when I attempted to implement it into the draft, it didn't allow me to collapse the other interviews. I found that counterintuitive, so I just didn't do it for the time being. If you have any tips on how to have collapses within collapses, I would love to know.

As for the other stuff, I worked from 5 in the morning and got off of work in the afternoon to make these great edits you suggest. Sorry man, but I wasn't in the right mind to attempt and add more. I've had a nap since then, so I'll try to fix this stuff before the day ends. I may or may not succeed.

item.title: Re: The Friendly Shadow
item.content:encoded:
You have definitely made some improvements, but there are still some issues here and there.

> Line by line < 
hide

Special Containment Procedures

Update: Following incident XXXX-A2, SCP-XXXX-1 has been provided with counseling and further educational within Site-17.

I would list the date the update occurred here and fix some spelling, and phrasing:1

Update: Following incident XXXX-A2, SCP-XXXX-1 has been provided with weekly counselling and a high-school education within Site-17.

Description

Update_Incident_XXXX-A2:SCP-XXXX-2 is a painting showing a silhouetted humanoid figure standing on a hill. Further information is limited to personnel above level 3 clearance.

Space needed between XXXX-A2: and SCP-XXXX-2. I also don't see the point of the lines between the words there. It could just be 'Update Incident XXXX-A2.

Discovery

3ed

should be

3rd

Addendum XXXX.

Mabye this should be called Addendum XXXX.1? It seems to make more sense to me.

Interview XXXX.1

It should be noted that SCP-XXXX is referred as "Thomas" by SCP-XXXX.

Would be phrased better as

It should be noted that SCP-XXXX-1 reffers to SCP-XXXX by the name "Thomas".

SCP-XXXX-1: "I knew he was in the Museum. I broke him inside in the first place."

Dr. Rose: "And what influenced you to break into the Museum?"

SCP-XXXX-1: "I was scared Thomas was stuck inside, he hadn’t come out in hours."

This seems weird to me. Dr Rose asks why he broke him inside in the first place, then -1 answers that he was already in there? Because Dr Rose doesn't bring him up on the discrepancy, I'd assume this wasn't intentional.

+ 'LEVEL 3 CLEARANCE REQUIRED - INPUT CREDENTIALS'

This should follow all of the following text (except for the navigator), as a government document wouldn't just redact one thing that can be discovered anyway with context clues. Also it probably shouldn't have the inverted commas around it.

> Overall < 
hide

While a lot of the spelling has been cleaned up, I think the article still suffers from some of the broader issues I pointed out earlier. For one, I think the article could benefit from an Image of either SCP-XXXX-1 or SCP-XXXX in order to break up the text.

I still think the experiment logs detract from the story and are kind of unnecessary. As I said before; this would be more interesting to me if we saw some more characterisation of SCP-XXXX-1 and SCP-XXXX, which could be used in place of the experimentation. Again, this is all my opinion, and I have not got any writing on the site, so take it with a grain of salt.

I think the most important thing this article is in need of is more characterisation because at this point the ending note just doesn't hit for me.

Feel free to PM me again if you make any changes to the article.

Footnotes
1. I'll just put the corrections underneath, as the crossing out and underlining makes everything feel cluttered.

item.title: Re: The Friendly Shadow
item.content:encoded:
Thank you so much for the critique! I didn’t realize how many mistakes I made. I’ve never wrote in a clinical tone before, so these are great tips. I’ll be sure to add the corrections once I get the chance.

And the deed has been done. Now I will be editing the interviews. I knew they were going to be the biggest challenge, next to making people actually care about the characters in such a short story.

item.title: Re: The Friendly Shadow
item.content:encoded:
I have not got anything on the main site, but here are my thoughts anyway - take these with a grain of salt. If you don't like a proposed change, feel free to ignore it.

+ > Line by Line < 
- Close


Things I would remove will be crossed out and Things I would add will be underlined, and things that could be decided by you [E.g specifics] are in [Square brackets]

Description

SCP-XXXX is the shadow of XXXX-1, Clarence Carter

I would change to

SCP-XXXX is the shadow of XXXX-1, a humanoid appearing as a [middle-aged] male of [indeterminent] descent. SCP-XXXX-1 self-identifies as Clarence Carter.

XXXX is a sapient shadow with the outlines of a mouth, eyes, and entire body which moves whenever active.

I would change to

SCP-XXXX is a sapient shadow with the has outlines of a mouth, eyes, and entire body which moves whenever active. The eyes and mouth appear as illuminated regions within the shadow.

This fixes some clinical tone issues, and makes the appearance clearer, I think.

XXXX has no way of talking to people outside of XXXX-1

Is not clinical. I would change it to

SCP-XXXX can communicate with SCP-XXXX-1 but is incapable of communicating with other organisms.

Stretching itself, XXXX is able to change into different forms.

Again, Clinical tone is off here.

SCP-XXXX is relatively amorphous, stretching and morphing into various forms at will.

XXXX can detach itself from XXXX-1 to interact with shadows of objects or people.

As well as changing XXXX and XXXX-1 to SCP-XXXX and SCP-XXXX-1 respectively, I would add the following for clarity.

XXXX can detach itself from XXXX-1 to interact with shadows of objects or people. Interactions with these shadows correspond to movements with the objects casting them.

Subject has only left XXXX-1 on rare occasions. Reasons are unknown. More information under Addendum XXXX.

Should be changed to something like:

Subject SCP-XXXX has only left loses contact with SCP-XXXX-1 on rare occasions. Reasons are unknown The cause of these incidents are unknown. More information under Addendum XXXX. For more information, see Addenda.

Discovery

SCP-XXXX's discovery was on December 3ed, 20██ in Charleston, West Virginia. XXXX-1's apprehension by authorities after breaking into the West Virginia State Museum made It clear that his shadow was nonexistent. Put into the police database, the Foundation took subject from custody for investigation. Two hours later, (after interrogation with XXXX-1) XXXX was contained by MTF Iota-10 ("Damn Feds"), with both subjects receiving their numbers.

Has some SPAG errors and poor phrasing, which I would recommend changing to this:

SCP-XXXX's discovery was SCP-XXXX was discovered on December 3erd, 20██ in Charleston, West Virginia. XXXX-1's apprehension by authorities after breaking into the West Virginia State Museum made It clear that his shadow was nonexistent. SCP-XXXX-1 was apprehended after breaking into Virginia State Museum. Following its arrest, it became clear that the entities shadow was non-existent. At this point, embedded foundation agents reported the anomaly and anesticised witnesses as necessary. Put into the police database, the Foundation took the subject from custody for investigation. _SCP-XXXX-1 was interrogated in foundation custody following its discovery. Two hours later, SCP-XXXX was contained by MTF Iota-10 ("Damn Feds"). The two objects were designated as SCP-XXXX shortly after.__(after interrogation with XXXX-1) XXXX was contained by MTF Iota-10 ("Damn Feds"), with both subjects receiving their numbers

Addendum XXXX.1

XXXX and XXXX-1 go through testing everyday at Six PM, testing the capabilities of XXXX's limitations. XXXX-1 frequently asks XXXX for advice and is a translator for tests. All investigation on XXXX-1's Family has come back with no results.

This phrasing unclear, and the sentence structure is a bit muddled. I would maybe change this to:

Following its discovery, SCP-XXXX and SCP-XXXX-1 were sent through a round of testing, which was designed to gauge SCP-XXXX's capabilities. On-site personnel have noted that SCP-XXXX-1 and SCP-XXXX regularly communicate, with SCP-XXXX-1 asking SCP-XXXX for personal advice, including discussions of SCP-XXXX-1's containment, and apparent amnesia. It should also be noted that investigation into the family or prior life of SCP-XXXX has been inconclusive.

This version establishes -1's 'amnesia' earlier, while also flowing a bit nicer (this is coming from a biased opinion though).

Foreword: The Interview was an attempt to uncover any origin/information of SCP-XXXX. The questions went without incident and both SCP-XXXX and -1 complied.

It should probably be noted here that -1 refers to XXXX as 'Thomas' as it introduces minor-confusion later on.

In terms of the interview in itself, I'll give my thoughts on the style in the 'Overall' section, but since I am horrible at writing dialogue, I'll just point out any typos I spotted.

<The desk would suddenly break apart, one of the limbs giving way. Review of the footage showed XXXX caused this for unknown reasons. Dr. Rose calls maintenance to replace the desk. The interview continued shortly after>

I don't see why this line's here. This doesn't really add much to the story, as far as I can tell. If you need to keep it in though, change it to:

<The desk would suddenly break apart, one of the limbs giving way. The desk breaks apart suddenly, with one leg collapsing. Review of the footage showed XXXX caused this for unknown reasons. show that SCP-XXXX caused this by interacting with the shadow of the desk. SCP-XXXX's motivations for this are unknown. Dr. Rose calls maintenance to replace the desk. The interview continued continues shortly after>

No, the police to me first.

You mean 'The police took me first'?

No luck. We’ve traveled half of America with no luck.

Maybe

"No luck. We travelled across half of America, still nothing"

SCP-XXXX: "I’m sorry, what? Am I being separated from Thomas?"

Do you mean SCP-XXXX-1?

SCP-XXXX: "Are you saying that I’m not being compliant now?"

Same here.

<Thomas appears to say something, Clarence looking over.>

Shouldn't this be 'SCP-XXXX' for thomas, and 'SCP-XXXX-1' for Clarence? Also, Interview transcripts are in the present tense, so it should be 'SCP-XXXX-1 looks over'.

<Thomas appears to speak over Clarence, Clarence going silent.>

Same applies here.

Expermiment Logs

I'm just gonna say it here, but the experiment logs seem to be kind of… useless? It kind of seems like a sudden, random shift from the main narrative rather than something useful. I would just specify some bits about how the anomaly works (like seeing in 2D) in the description.

Update XXXX

After further investigation in the State Museum where SCP-XXXX was found, Agent Hart found Agent Wolf had disappeared while examining a painting on exhibit. Item has been taken for further investigation. Most certainly has a connection to SCP-XXXX.

I would describe the painting here. Also, maybe change 'Most certainly' to 'It is believed this painting has a connection to SCP-XXXX

Interview XXXX.4

The same thing applies as with the interview above.

<Subject gives a smile>

Maybe just "SCP-XXXX smiles."

<XXXX swiftly wrote two giant letters on the second page, taking the whole paper up>

I would change to

<SCP-XXXX writes two large letters on the second page, covering the paper.>

<XXXX appears grief stricken>

Is unclinical. Maybe say

<SCP-XXXX appears distressed>

Interview XXXX-6

I DON'T HAVE A FAMILY, I DON'T HAVE AMNESIA, AND THOMAS IS JUST A FUCKING LIAR!"

I don't know if a transcription would emphasise text in upper case to show shouting, but that's just me.

Dr. Doxon: "…"

Should change to

<Dr. Doxon remains silent.>

Closing Statement: SCP-XXXX-1 has gone into forms of irritation and depression. Upon going through a psych eval, it was concluded that XXXX-1's IQ is 80, and while being in the body of a man in his early 30s, he has the mental intelligence of a teenager.

Could be changed to

Following Interview XXXX-6, SCP-XXXX-1 has been diagnosed with anxiety and clinical depression. Psychiatric evaluation by foundation also concluded that SCP-XXXX-1 has experienced a significantly stunted psychiatric development. Based on these findings, the Intelligence Quotient (IQ) of the subject has been determined as 80, with a mental age of 15.

Or something of the like.

Final Update

+ XXXX's Message

Maybe should be

+ Open File

The inside of the message is fine as far as I can tell.

+ > Overall < 
- Close

Overall, this article is a bit meh… The emotional core of the article doesn't really hit for me, as I just don't feel invested in these two characters. I would replace the experiment logs with a bit of communication between the anomaly, in order to show their personalities when together.

The Article also lacks a hook, with a pretty stock standard opening. This is by no means bad, but It could be improved by adding an update to the containment procedures saying "Following incident XXXX.1 (the discovery of the painting), SCP-XXXX-1 has been provided with counselling and further educational within [Site-102]1." This addition serves to give the reader a hint of what to expect from the article. I would also add the painting discovered as SCP-XXXX-2, describing it nebulously as 'SCP-XXXX-2 is a painting showing a silhouetted humanoid figure standing on a hill. Further information is limited to personnel above level 3 clearance.' Then maybe add a 'LEVEL 3 CLEARANCE REQUIRED - INPUT CREDENTIALS' over the discovery of SCP-XXXX-2. This hooks the reader without spoiling the mystery.

Other stuff I noted, the interviews dialogue feels a bit… weird? -1 doesn't really have an established personality, and XXXX itself is… so bad at lying its silly. Furthermore; the speech just doesn't strike me as … realistic? I don't know how to describe it, but it seems just weirdly worded. If the researchers noted this, it could add more to the idea that SCP-XXXX-1 was created from nothing, but to me it feels unitentional. Karablue may be able to suggest proper changes to the interviews.

With a few changes however, I think this could be really good. I'd recommend reading some other emotional articles to see what works, and revising the story to flow better. But again, this doesn't strike me as a 'first author series one-clone', rather having actual substance behind it. Good luck if you managed to get through this wall of text!

P.S: Once you have revised the article, feel free to PM me again, and I'll check it over again. Good luck with getting this on the site.

Footnotes
1. It can be literally any site, but you know what I mean

item.title: Re: The Friendly Shadow
item.content:encoded:
[Place Holder o' Doom!!! Will crit with 24 hours]

Howdy, apologies for this taking so long!

+ Line by line and general thoughts.
- ...

Line by Line

SCP-XXXX is to be kept in a humanoid containment cell with standard necessities.

The standard necessities could be omitted just because it is assumed. Maybe try something like "SCP-XXXX is to be contained in a standard humanoid containment chamber." (I changed it to chamber, but you could get away with cell.)

LED spotlights must be around the subject's cell, allowing no shadows in contact with the cell. Any change in SCP-XXXX is to be reported immediately.

Clinical tone: "LED spotlights must surround the cell, ensuring no shadows come in contact with it. Any change in SCP-XXXX is to be reported immediately."

Following incident XXXX-A2, SCP-XXXX-1 has been provided with counseling and further educational within Site-17.

This feels unnecessary. You could axe the "Update:" line all together.

SCP-XXXX is the shadow of XXXX-1, a humanoid appearing as a 32 year old male of Caucasian descent. SCP-XXXX-1 self-identifies as Clarence Carter.

Delete the "self" part of "self-identifies".

SCP-XXXX has outlines of a mouth, eyes, and entire body which moves whenever active.

Try "SCP-XXXX has the illuminated outline of a mouth, eyes, and body similar to that of SCP-XXXX-1." then delete the sentence right after that.

SCP-XXXX can communicate with SCP-XXXX-1 but is incapable of communicating with other organisms.

Try "SCP-XXXX is capable of communication with SCP-XXXX-1 but is unable to communicate with other organisms."

SCP-XXXX can detach itself from XXXX-1 to interact with shadows of objects or people.

"SCP-XXXX is able to detach itself from SCP-XXXX-1 to interact with shadows of objects or people."

Interactions with these shadows correspond to movements with the objects casting them.

Try "Interactions with these shadows correspond to movements with the objects creating them."

SCP-XXXX only loses contact with XXXX-1 on rare occasions. The cause of these incidents are unknown. For more information, see Addenda.

What does this mean? He can detach from -1 at any time, so what is the point of these sentences?

Update_Incident_XXXX-A2:SCP-XXXX-2 is a painting showing a silhouetted humanoid figure standing on a hill. Further information is limited to personnel above level 3 clearance.

Missing a space, should be "Update_Incident_XXXX-A2: SCP-XXXX-2 is a painting showing a silhouetted humanoid figure standing on a hill. Further information is limited to personnel above level 3 clearance." Further more, I don't see why this is important since you just gave that and there is an entire other addendum dedicated to SCP-XXXX-2.

SCP-XXXX-1 was apprehended after breaking into Virginia State Museum. Following its arrest, it became clear that the entities shadow was non-existent.

Could be "Following SCP-XXXX-1's arrest at the Virginia State Museum, it was observed that SCP-XXXX-1 did not have a shadow."

At this point, embedded foundation agents reported the anomaly and anesticised witnesses as necessary.

"Embedded Foundation agents reported the anomaly and removed it." or "Embedded Foundation agents reported the anomaly and amnesticised witnesses." Though, I figure most people wouldn't care enough to notice a shadow. I don't remember the last time I noticed a shadow.

SCP-XXXX-1 was interrogated in foundation custody following its discovery. Two hours later, SCP-XXXX was contained by MTF Iota-10 ("Damn Feds"). The two objects were designated as SCP-XXXX shortly after.

Try "SCP-XXXX-1 was interrogated in Foundation custody following its discovery. SCP-XXXX was contained by MTF Iota-10 ("Damn Feds"). The two objects were collectively designated as SCP-XXXX."

Following its discovery, SCP-XXXX and SCP-XXXX-1 were sent through a round of testing, which was designed to gauge SCP-XXXX's capabilities.

Ehh, I don't think this is entirely necessary. Just cut it all together.

The Interview was an attempt to uncover any origin/information of SCP-XXXX. The questions went without incident and both SCP-XXXX and -1 complied. It should be noted that SCP-XXXX is referred as "Thomas" by SCP-XXXX.

Try "The Interview was an attempt to uncover any information of SCP-XXXX's origin. It should be noted that SCP-XXXX is referred as "Thomas" by SCP-XXXX."

SCP-XXXX-1 seems highly trustful of SCP-XXXX, and did not hesitate in answering accordingly and truthfully. Possible that he’s holding back on details. He made a sudden change of opinion on the topic of whether to be separated from SCP-XXXX in further interviews when SCP-XXXX made an abrupt change of pace. -Dr. Rose

Try "SCP-XXXX-1 seems highly trustful of SCP-XXXX, and did not hesitate in answering accordingly. It is possible that he’s holding back on details. He made a sudden change of opinion on the topic of whether to be separated from SCP-XXXX in further interviews when SCP-XXXX made an abrupt change of pace. -Dr. Rose" Though the wording on "He made a sudden change of opinion on" is still worded a little weird.

SCP-XXXX, take the wallet and open it's contents. If able, count the contents.

"SCP-XXXX is to take the wallet and open it's contents. If able, count the contents." All of the instructions should be written this way or similar.

XXXX moves to be across the wall the desk is against with the contents. XXXX's arm goes across the wall to the table, interacting with the wallet's Shadow. Upon interaction, shadow of the wallet went to the wall, as XXXX lifted it up. The psychical wallet hovered in the air, forcing itself to align with the shadow. SCP-XXXX took all contents out and organized them properly back into the wallet, before putting it back down.

All of the XXXX's need SCP- in front of them.

Item has been taken for further investigation. It is believed this painting has a connection to SCP-XXXX. The item has been labeled SCP-XXXX-2. Efforts to retrieve Agent Wolf in progress.

Try "The item was taken for further investigation. It is believed this painting has a connection to SCP-XXXX. This item has been designated SCP-XXXX-2. Efforts to retrieve Agent Wolf are in progress."

After the retrieval of the anomalous painting, it was imperative to question SCP-XXXX for any information on the item, and further investigation into it's past with XXXX-1. XXXX was given a green-screen and chair to manifest on without the presence of XXXX-1. A journal and pen were supplied for XXXX to answer the questions.

"After the retrieval of SCP-XXXX-2, it was imperative to question SCP-XXXX for any information on the item. SCP-XXXX was given a green-screen and chair to manifest on without the presence of SCP-XXXX-1. A journal and pen were supplied for SCP-XXXX to answer the questions."

"We found a painting in the Museum where you were found. Does that sound familiar to you?"

"We found a painting in the Museum. Does that sound familiar to you?"

SCP-XXXX and XXXX-1 has stopped all communication. Dr. Doxon was tasked with understand what had happened during Audio_Log_XXXX-52.

We know the first part. Try "Dr. Doxon was tasked with understand what had happened during Audio_Log_XXXX-52."

"XXXX-1. Before we begin tests, do you mind if I you sit down and we have some quick chit-chat?'

Try ""XXXX-1. Before we begin tests, do you mind if I you sit down and we have some quick chit-chat?"" (With the " instead of ')

Following Interview XXXX-6, SCP-XXXX-1 has been diagnosed with anxiety and clinical depression. Psychiatric evaluation by foundation also concluded that SCP-XXXX-1 has experienced a significantly stunted psychiatric development. Based on these findings, the Intelligence Quotient (IQ) of the subject has been determined as 80, with a mental age of 15.

I'm not sure why the first part is entirely necessary. I would suggest cutting it all together just having "Psychiatric evaluation by foundation also concluded that SCP-XXXX-1 has experienced a significantly stunted psychiatric development. Based on these findings, the Intelligence Quotient (IQ) of the subject has been determined as 80, with a mental age of 15."

The note at the end.

Could be done as

 > Clarence, > > I didn't mean to hurt you. I didn't mean to lie to you. I only wished to keep you safe. You were the first thing I saw in this world. You were the only thing that kept me going. It's true, that I used you to get back home. But I just wanted to teach you how to live before I left. I knew you couldn't survive without me, so I tried my hardest to teach you everything I knew. This world is cold, dark, and unforgiving. You were my shadow and I was yours. I found my way back home. > > But… > > I didn't know what would happen to you if I left. > > You could have disappeared the moment I went back. > > So I stayed. > > I let myself get caught." > > Just to make sure you were okay. > > Please forgive me. > > Your friend, Thomas

I would also be weary that this can fall to the "Note at the end" trope.

Minor Nitpick

I dislike when people add dates and black box some of the numbers. Its not a big deal if you do, I am just particular. Honestly, its up to you to keep them or not.

Final Notes

Take out "+ SCP-XXXX Experiments" It doesn't do much other than fill space. I noticed that you have an issue with "SCP-XXXX's" more so the "SCP-" part. You're missing it in almost every instance of XXXX.

Hmm, alright. I think this is alright. Aside from a few issues I pointed out above. I think this could go far. I am worried about the emotional hits coming off a little weird though. We don't entirely have much reason to care for SCP-XXXX and SCP-XXXX-1. Other than that, good job.

Good luck!

I suggest taking this to cybersqyd or MalyceGraves for more critique.

item.title: The Friendly Shadow
item.content:encoded:
Aloha guys! Here's my first attempt at an SCP. It's filled with 3,071 words. I know it definitely needs work, but because I'm basically blind, I'm sure whoever stumbles upon this can easily correct my mistakes faster.
So, have at it: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/drcope

Greenlights in the replies.

Brief Intro: It's a living shadow attached to a human (Clarence).

I believe I must certainly work on the Interviews. Other than that, I'm not observant or educated enough to see what else needs corrected. To anyone about to Crit this, thanks. I always need help.
